title: ci: mirror full Sonar details into PR comments
body:
## Objetivo

Evitar depender del endpoint incompleto de GitHub cuando SonarQube Cloud tiene detalles que no quedan visibles en el check.

## Cambios

- añade `.github/workflows/sonar-pr-details.yml`
- añade `scripts/sonar-pr-comment.py`
- escucha el check externo `SonarCloud Code Analysis`
- consulta la Web API de SonarQube Cloud
- crea o actualiza un único comentario estable en la PR
- incluye Quality Gate, condiciones, issues, Security Hotspots, archivo/línea, regla, estado e impactos
- deriva automáticamente el project key desde el check nativo de Sonar
- soporta `SONAR_TOKEN` opcional si la API requiere autenticación
- no añade un segundo scanner ni reemplaza Automatic Analysis
- añade validación de sintaxis del reporter en GrindFlow CI
- formaliza la regla en AGENTS.md y DEVELOPMENT-MODEL.md

## Seguridad

El workflow se ejecuta con `check_run: completed` sobre la rama por defecto y no ejecuta código de la PR. Solo reacciona cuando la app es `sonarqubecloud` y el check es `SonarCloud Code Analysis`.

## Prueba end-to-end

La primera validación real del comentario sincronizado se hará con la siguiente PR visual, después de que este workflow exista en `main`.

body:
## P0

Implements the **reproducible Hostinger deploy** work item from the README.

## Changes

- adds `scripts/deploy-hostinger.sh`
- adds `docs/DEPLOY-HOSTINGER.md`
- marks the old Next.js/VPS deployment guide as legacy reference

Production migrations remain a separate explicit operator action after reviewing the migration set and using the migration/owner DB role.

title: fix: route Hostinger to Laravel public entrypoint
body:
## Problema

Hostinger despliega el repositorio en `public_html`, pero Laravel expone su entrada web en `public/index.php`.

Sin reglas de Apache en la raíz, el dominio devuelve **403 Forbidden** al intentar listar la raíz del proyecto.

## Cambio

- añade `.htaccess` en la raíz para enrutar internamente a `public/`
- añade `public/.htaccess` con las reglas estándar de front controller de Laravel

## Resultado esperado

`https://www.grindflow.com.co/` debe llegar a Laravel sin exponer `/public` en la URL.

## Nota de despliegue

Si después del 403 aparece un 500, el siguiente punto a verificar en Hostinger será que el deploy ejecute `composer install` y tenga `.env` / `APP_KEY` configurados.

## Status

IMPLEMENTED. Pending GrindFlow CI / validate.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added support for clean public URLs.
  * Improved request routing for application pages and non-file paths.
  * Preserved authorization and security headers during requests.
  * Disabled directory listing and ambiguous path matching for improved access control.

title: feat: add identity and tenant isolation (GF-MIG-002)
body:
## Requirements

Implements:
- **GF-MIG-002 — Identity and organizations**
- **GF-FR-001 — Organization isolation**
- **GF-SEC-002 — Server-side authorization**
- **GF-SEC-003 — CSRF/session protection**

## What lands

- Laravel session authentication with login/logout and rate limiting
- UUID users, organizations and memberships
- legacy-compatible roles: admin, studio, model, editor
- Laravel Policies for organizations and memberships
- PostgreSQL Row Level Security on organizations and memberships
- transaction-scoped `app.current_user_id` context for RLS
- explicit tenant middleware for authenticated requests
- organization-aware queue middleware that revalidates authorization before job execution
- dashboard restricted to visible organizations
- negative cross-tenant PostgreSQL tests
- protection against self role escalation and membership identity mutation
- durable identity/tenancy architecture documentation

## RLS deployment contract

Production application traffic must use a PostgreSQL role that:
- is not a superuser
- does not have BYPASSRLS
- does not own protected tables

Schema migrations should use a separate migration/owner role.

CI verifies the RLS contract by switching to a dedicated unprivileged database role before attempting cross-tenant access.

## Migration safety

This does not alter the legacy Supabase migration history or remove TypeScript identity code. The Laravel schema is the target implementation; a deliberate data migration comes later.

## Status

**VALIDATED IN CODE** on head `a4c0c1e505becc62e652b228ab94a38e8dc48aa5`.

- GrindFlow CI / validate: green
- PostgreSQL RLS database gate: green
- Pint / Larastan / PHPUnit: green
- CodeRabbit: all review threads resolved
- SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate: green, 0 security hotspots; 1 non-blocking issue remains for manual inspection in SonarCloud

Production database role separation and production migration are deliberately left for the next P0.
